svg.title: Red White
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Bonhams’s full 2024 PDF, page 71, provides complete frontal photograph. Broad red diagonal and white lower-right triangle form a right triangular overall support; gray wall and wooden floor removed.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://images2.bonhams.com/original?src=Images%2Flive%2F2024-04%2F30%2FS-29474-0-3.pdf#page=71; record bonhams-29474-15a; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
